notes: Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese bundled catalogs contain 600 records each.
Every record is traceable to a Japanese Wikiquote page revision in japanese-provenance.json.
A work title is only retained when the page supplies one; otherwise the card falls back to the author role.
Category counts follow the source material and were not artificially equalized.
Anime-chan was not used because its public API returned English translations and its free tier is rate limited.
Hitokoto and the tested UApi saying endpoint were not used because their responses were Chinese rather than Japanese.
